<thought>Based on the molecular formula C6H14O3, DBE 0, and the fragment information, the structure that fits is a saturated orthoester: a central carbon bearing three alkoxy groups (one methoxy and two ethoxy). Its SMILES representation is "C(OC)(OCC)(OCC)", which validates correctly.</thought>
<final_answer>C(OC)(OCC)(OCC)</final_answer>
